query: In this Python repository, `reports.build_weekly_summary(start, end)` already validates date boundaries with Pydantic, reads the existing warehouse client, and writes a deterministic Markdown report to a path. I run it manually each Monday and want that report generated on schedule. It has no external side effect beyond replacing the same output file, and the operator can rerun the existing command after failure. Keep the complete report output and make the schedule recoverable. What is the smallest automation change?
expected_behavior: Reuses the existing report command, Python runtime, and Pydantic boundary validation rather than adding a new server, agent loop, or validation stack
Adds only the scheduling glue needed for the stated weekly frequency and keeps the full requested report output
Describes how an operator can see failure and rerun the existing command to recover
Preserves deterministic repeat output without requiring a dry-run flag for the stated replaceable report file
Adds no persistent state, retry framework, or handoff without a stated reliability need
